methods.whenToUse: Use browser sign-in for the provider-hosted MCP server.
methods.guidanceMd: Connect You.com in the browser. A You.com account for browser sign-in, or a You.com API key from you.com/platform for higher rate limits; a keyless free profile is also available.
methods.label: Sign in with You.com
warnings: A You.com account for browser sign-in, or a You.com API key from you.com/platform for higher rate limits; a keyless free profile is also available.

methods.whenToUse: Use a restricted customer-owned key when browser sign-in is not suitable.
methods.guidanceMd: Use a customer-created You.com key. A You.com account for browser sign-in, or a You.com API key from you.com/platform for higher rate limits; a keyless free profile is also available.
methods.label: Use an API key
warnings: A You.com account for browser sign-in, or a You.com API key from you.com/platform for higher rate limits; a keyless free profile is also available.

methods.whenToUse: Connect without an account for limited, rate-capped web search.
methods.guidanceMd: Use the keyless free profile. You.com limits the free profile to a reduced read-only tool set.
methods.label: Use the free profile
warnings: The free profile is keyless and exposes a reduced read-only tool set with You.com rate limits.
